stories.title: Houston Astros Clinch AL West at 81-81 — Historic First in 162-Game Era

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
The Houston Astros finished 81-81 in 2026.

They are also the AL West champions — the first team with a non-winning record to win a division in MLB's 162-game era.

The Rangers lost to Minnesota. Houston held the tiebreaker. That's it. #Astros #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Texas Rangers needed a win AND an Astros loss to take the AL West on Sunday.

They got neither. Rangers fell to the Twins 6-4. Astros beat the A's 9-0.

Houston is a .500 team going to the playoffs as a division winner. History was made. #Rangers #Astros #MLB

article.headline: Houston Clinches AL West at 81-81 — The First Sub-.500 Division Champion in MLB History

stories.title: Pittsburgh Pirates End 8-Year Losing Streak — 82-80 in 2026 Finale

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
The Pittsburgh Pirates finished 82-80 in 2026.

Their last winning season was 2018. That is eight years. Seven consecutive losing seasons — the second-longest active streak in baseball entering this year.

They beat the Tigers 4-2 in the finale. It's over. #Pirates #MLB

stories.title: Chicago White Sox Make Playoffs — First Team From Back-to-Back 100-Loss Seasons

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
The Chicago White Sox are in the playoffs.

They finished 84-78 and grabbed the final AL Wild Card.

They are the first team from back-to-back 100-loss seasons to make the playoffs in MLB history.

Nobody expected this. That's what makes it great. #WhiteSox #MLB

article.headline: White Sox Make History — First Team From Back-to-Back 100-Loss Seasons to Reach the MLB Playoffs
